## Core Offerings on www.cbcmaterials.shop
- **2026 KICD Rationalized CBC Schemes of Work:** 10-column TSC/KICD compliant Term 1, Term 2 & Term 3 schemes (Editable Word .DOCX + Print .PDF) citing KICD Orange Book page numbers (KSh 50).
- **CBC Lesson Plans:** Complete termly lesson-by-lesson booklets aligned 1:1 with schemes of work (KSh 70).
- **CBC Teachers' Notes & Short Point-Form Revision Books:** Comprehensive all-strand chalkboard notes and 50p/100p books (CBC Grade Up, Super-Light CBC Compilation, Smart CBC All Subjects).
- **TSC Services Hub:** Dedicated teacher guides for TSC TPAD 2 lesson observations, T-Pay payslips & P9 tax forms, Wealth Declaration, recruitment/promotions, and Records of Work Covered with EE/ME/AE/BE rubrics.
- **KNEC, KJSEA, KPSEA & Termly Examinations:** 210 standalone National KJSEA Test papers + 210 separate official marking schemes, KPSEA Grade 6 trials, KEYA Grade 3 assessments, and Opener/Mid/End-Term exams.
- **Nationwide Tuition & Tutors:** Vetted home and online CBC tutor matching across all 47 counties in Kenya.
- **Tutor Peter Whiteboard Video Lessons & AI Homework Q&A:** Interactive classroom tutorials and step-by-step CBC homework solver.
